objective.statement: Learn six words of feeling: agitato, mesto, triste, amore, anima and animato.
successCriteria: I know agitato is agitated and animato is animated and lively.
I know mesto and triste are both sad.
I know amore means love and anima means soul or spirit, as in con anima.

explanation.text: Composers use words of feeling to show the mood of the music. Agitato is restless. Mesto and triste are both sad. Amore is love. Anima is soul or spirit. Animato is animated and lively.
“agitato” means agitated and restless. “mesto” means sad. “triste” means sad and sorrowful. “amore” means love.
“anima” means soul or spirit. “animato” means animated and lively.
Amoroso means loving. Con anima means with feeling, or spirited. Animando means becoming more lively. Triste may also be written tristamente.

explanation.caption: Con anima above the first bar: with feeling, or spirited.

explanation.text: Restless: agitato. Sad: mesto, triste. Love: amore. Soul or spirit: anima. Lively: animato.

It means agitated: restless and unsettled.
It describes the mood. Play with energy and a feeling of unrest.
